finding.statement: On the n-fold fibre product C^n of the universal curve over M_g, the class omega_s=pr_s^* c_1(omega_{C/M_g}) is not homogeneous for the Kunneth multi-index: it decomposes as a_s+b_s+c_s with a_s in H^2(M_g) (slot value 0), b_s in H^1(M_g;V) (slot value 1) and c_s the R^2 component (slot value 2, coefficient 2g-2). Only c_s carries the i_s=0 to i_s=2 isomorphism, so any argument of the form 'multiplication by psi_s spans the i_s=2 summands modulo the summands with some slot 0' must dispose of the slot-1 cross term b_s. Two disposals are valid: H^1(Mod_g;H_1(Sigma_g;Q))=0 for g>=2 (Morita: the integral group is Z/(2g-2)), which makes b_s=0 identically; or a downward induction on |i| using A_i=c_s B_{i'} inside omega_s B_{i'}+A_{i'}+A_{i''} with |i''|=|i|-1 and the base case A_j=0 for k-|j|>vcd(M_g).
